comment: Shared vectors: tools/CoopPlay.psm1 Get-CoopLinkReasonText / Get-CoopSteamEndText, native/coop_reason_text.cpp and the Diamond Dogs Together launcher core (native/launcher/core/core_text.cpp) must produce these exact sentences (tests/friend_package_tests.ps1, tests/steam_transport_tests.cpp, tests/ddt_core_tests.cpp). Steam online play, the launcher's wording: no PowerShell tool and no LAN/VPN code.
